paragraphs.text: Kiran Nalaar was the father of Chandra Nalaar and the husband of Pia Nalaar .

Pia and Kiran Nalaar were inventors, who secretly trafficked a controlled substance, the mystical aether , to those who needed it. He and his wife often hotwired cars, and he once held the record for the most speeding tickets in the city of Ghirapur . When they discovered that their daughter was a fire mage, they fled Ghirapur to escape the Consulate forces that would try to eliminate what they perceived to be a threat. After their hiding place — the village of Burarat — was burned down by the troops of Captain Baral , Kiran was killed, Chandra was taken away to be executed and Pia was jailed.
In the Echoverse , Kiran was never killed by the Consulate and instead helped run it. Chandra followed in his footsteps, becoming an ice mage and serving as a Consulate enforcer.
